description.text: The eighth set of the EX series, released in February 2005 with 108 cards, 107 numbered and a secret Rocket's Raikou ex. It follows the seventh film, Destiny Deoxys: Deoxys comes in its Normal, Attack and Defense forms, as Pokémon and as Pokémon-ex that switch between forms with the Form Change Poké-Power, and with them every third-generation Pokémon had a card. Rayquaza has three cards, one of them a Pokémon Star beside Latias and Latios, and the Trainers come from the people and places of astronomy in the Hoenn games, such as Professor Cozmo's Discovery.
